title: India-EU FTA concluded (26 Jan) → MFN status confirmed (Mar)

items: concluded after 18 years of on-off talks. EU FDI in India >€132 billion (2024).
EU is 2nd-largest goods trading partner. India to allow EU banks **15 branches over 4 years** (up from 12).
insurance FDI bound at **100%**. 13 agreements signed during Costa/von der Leyen visit (16th India-EU Summit, 27 Jan).
** 🔄 Update:** India-EU to grant each other **Most Favoured Nation (MFN) status for 5 years**, effective from FTA entry into force.
4th-year Joint Committee review; auto-terminates unless mutually extended.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — "22nd FTA partner" + "15 EU bank branches/4 yrs" + "MFN 5 years" is the testable core; don't confuse the 100% insurance-FDI **bound commitment** here with the separate domestic 100% FDI-in-insurance reform (Section 3, Feb).
